sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Acid, Acid Spray, Circle Throw, Dragon Tail, Drum Beating, Fake Out, First Impression, Frustration, Outrage, Rage, Rollout, Stomping Tantrum, and Thrash: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Normal-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Boomburst, Bug Buzz, Chatter, Clanging Scales, Clangorous Soul, Clangorous Soulblaze, Disarming Voice, Dragon Dance, Drum Beating, Echoed Voice, Feather Dance, Fiery Dance, First Impression, Growl, Howl, Hyper Voice, Metal Sound, Noble Roar, Overdrive, Parting Shot, Petal Dance, Quiver Dance, Relic Song, Revelation Dance, Roar, Rollout, Round, Screech, Sing, Snarl, Sparkling Aria, Supersonic, Swagger, Swords Dance, Uproar, and Work Up change the field into Concert Venue 2.
Focus Energy, Follow Me, Laser Focus, Lucky Chant, and Spotlight change the field into Concert Venue 3.
Explosion and Self-Destruct change the field into Concert Venue 4.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Heavy Metal, Punk Rock, Rock Head, Solid Rock, or Soundproof: Defense +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Progression
lines: Stage 1 of 4: the crowd grows through its stages and shrinks again.
Entering Pokémon with Galvanize, Heavy Metal, Plus, Punk Rock, or Solid Rock grow it.
Seeds grow it. Lowering accuracy or raising evasion shrinks it.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Special Attack +1 and gains a special effect.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
